kinyarwanda_draft: Isuzuma ryihuse ry'intege nke z'ubukungu mu rugo

english: Please provide an answer or select 'I don't know'.
Does anyone carry out agricultural or livestock activity?
kinyarwanda_draft: Hari umuntu wo muri uru rugo ukora ubuhinzi cyangwa ubworozi?

english: Does anyone operate a non-farm business?
kinyarwanda_draft: Hari umuntu wo muri uru rugo ufite ubucuruzi cyangwa undi murimo utari ubuhinzi?

english: Does the household have electricity access?
What is the main floor material?
kinyarwanda_draft: Hasi mu nzu hakozwe mu ki?

english: How many people, children and elderly people live in the household?
kinyarwanda_draft: Ni abantu bangahe baba muri uru rugo, harimo abana n'abantu bageze mu zabukuru?

english: How many household members currently have health insurance?
kinyarwanda_draft: Ni abantu bangahe muri uru rugo bafite ubwishingizi bw'ubuzima?

english: Has anyone in the household used the internet during the last three months?
kinyarwanda_draft: Hari umuntu wo muri uru rugo wakoresheje interineti mu mezi atatu ashize?

english: Approximately how many livestock does the household own?
Does anyone in the household have a mobile telephone?
kinyarwanda_draft: Hari umuntu wo muri uru rugo ufite telefoni igendanwa?

english: How many rooms are mainly used for sleeping?
kinyarwanda_draft: Ni ibyumba bingahe bikoreshwa cyane cyane mu kuryamamo?

english: Does anyone currently work for a wage or salary?
kinyarwanda_draft: Hari umuntu wo muri uru rugo ukorera umushahara?

english: Fewer than 60% of the questions were answered. Please provide more information or request assistance.
kinyarwanda_draft: Hasubijwe munsi ya 60% by'ibibazo. Tanga andi makuru cyangwa usabe ubufasha mu kuzuza isuzuma.

english: Only 60–79% of the questions were answered. Interpret this screening result with additional caution.
kinyarwanda_draft: Hasubijwe hagati ya 60% na 79% by'ibibazo. Koresha iki gisubizo witonze.

english: This does not prove that the household is not vulnerable. The quick screen can miss households that need support. You may request a complete assessment.
kinyarwanda_draft: Ibi ntibivuze ko urugo rudakeneye ubufasha. Iri suzuma rishobora kutabona ingo zimwe zikeneye ubufasha. Ushobora gusaba isuzuma rirambuye.

english: No elevated risk detected from this quick screening
kinyarwanda_draft: Nta kimenyetso gikomeye cyagaragajwe n'iri suzuma ryihuse

english: Your answers suggest that a more complete assessment may be helpful. This result does not automatically determine eligibility for assistance.
kinyarwanda_draft: Ibisubizo watanze bigaragaza ko isuzuma rirambuye rishobora gufasha. Ibi ntibihita byemeza ko urugo rwemerewe ubufasha.
Hashobora kuba hari intege nke z'ubukungu

english: This quick screen has lower sensitivity for households with one to three members. Please request a complete assessment if you have concerns or need support.
kinyarwanda_draft: Iri suzuma ryihuse ntiribona neza intege nke z'ubukungu mu ngo zigizwe n'abantu umwe kugeza kuri batatu. Saba isuzuma rirambuye niba ufite impungenge cyangwa ukeneye ubufasha.

english: A trained officer should review decisions involving benefits, credit, insurance or public assistance.
kinyarwanda_draft: Umukozi wabihuguriwe agomba gusuzuma ibyemezo bijyanye n'ubufasha, inguzanyo cyangwa ubwishingizi.

english: Do not enter names, national identification numbers or telephone numbers. The screening does not require them.
kinyarwanda_draft: Ntushyiremo amazina, nimero y'indangamuntu cyangwa nimero ya telefoni. Iri suzuma ntiribikeneye.

english: This is an initial screening result, not an official poverty classification or automatic eligibility decision.
kinyarwanda_draft: Iki ni igisubizo cy'isuzuma ry'ibanze gusa. Si icyemezo cya leta ku cyiciro cy'ubukene kandi ntigihita cyemeza uwemerewe ubufasha.
